name: NPC Sample
description: Sample for friendly NPCs and native quests (docs/kiln/services/npcs.md): Tobin, a new NPC (a clone of the fisher trader with its own GUID, name, dialogue and roster entry), a short voiced quest in the game's own journal with map markers, a trade at the fisher's workshop, and a summon tool. Install on the server and on every player's game: the client builds its journal and templates from quests/*.json at boot. Voice clips are SoundSample's test tones: build the assets first (build-assets.sh). In game: /npcsample here.
